To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) smartphone based passive data collection is a feasible method for assessing mental health issues on a college campus; 2) the passive data collected by our smartphone app can help in the detection of depression, self-harm, and suicidal ideation; and 3) passive data collection is useful for identifying students at risk of developing mental health issues.

(i) we found that students who suffer from mental health issues are more likely to have a lower number of social interactions, and (ii) students who suffer from anxiety issues are more likely have a higher number of social interactions.

(1) smartphone sensors can be used to detect the presence of depression and anxiety symptoms, (2) the detection of depression symptoms can be improved by using a combination of sensor data and self-reported information, and (3) the detection of anxiety symptoms can be improved using a combination of sensors and self-reported information.
